steps.code:
# Get all albums in the user's library (paginate)
albums = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    result = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not result:
        break
    albums.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total albums: {len(albums)}")
print(albums[:2])
